payload.title: Decision (Ryan): embedding asset acquisition, feature gating, CI determinism
payload.description:
A decision gate, not implementation — the rest of this epic stays blocked until this task closes with Ryan's answers in a comment.

**The open questions** (also posted on BOTSPY-c7795b): (1) where the ~80 MB quantized all-MiniLM-L6-v2 weights + tokenizer.json come from — library-managed first-launch fetch, consumer/CLI-managed download, or an explicit install step — given the README FAQ's nothing-leaves-the-machine promise and offline-deterministic CI; (2) whether real-model support ships behind a cargo feature (e.g. `semantic`; tract + tokenizers is a heavy dependency tree) or in core; (3) which real-model specs run in CI (a tiny committed ONNX fixture vs feature-gated/ignored tests).

**Do not start the implementation tasks until this closes.**

Gates: cargo fmt --all; cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings; RUSTDOCFLAGS="-D warnings" cargo doc --no-deps; cargo test and cargo test --test bdd. All existing suites stay green (features/01_structure, features/03_importers, features/04_examples, features/cli).
